Five South Capitol Street rows, Martin Luther King Jr Ave SE to Mississippi Ave SE, were taken out on 2026-10-05 for OWNER-DECISIONS 432 ("Change south captiol street from MLK ave to Missisipi ave to LTS4"): that stretch is LTS 4 by a named corridor (fixtures/corridors/). Everything under `retire` is withdrawn when this file is loaded again: the 529 retire entries are the rows already loaded, the 5 of 432 and the 524 of 445 and 445f (load_access_overrides; docs/OPERATIONS.md, the rebuild bundle's step H). Load it before the military reopenings file.
annotations: The owner, 2026-09-30 (OWNER-DECISIONS 141): "Make arterials LTS 3 or greater unless there s bike infrastructure. I d put most of the Arterials east of the Anacostia river as avoid." Asked which to strike (OWNER-DECISIONS 144): struck "11th St SE", "Ridge Rd SE", "River bridges"; everything else (South Capitol St SW included) is approved to load as Avoid. The District's trunk, primary and secondary ways east of the Anacostia River, placed by the state boundary and the river's OSM line in the Geofabrik extract of 2026-09-25, less every way named 11th Street Southeast or Ridge Road Southeast and the four ways that cross the river (the river bridges), and less nine ways the 2026-09-27 file already curates. Overpass bridges well away from the river stay in by design; asked whether they should (OWNER-DECISIONS 177), the owner said: "Yes, keep them in". Tier 5, hidden, no public_note, category other, annotation approved. The two Saint Elizabeths Rd SE rows (316866053, 1181165198) were taken out on 2026-10-06 for OWNER-DECISIONS 437c ("St Elizabeths road is open to bikes, but It's LTS4."): 2026-10-06-owner-military-reopenings.json retires them and rates the road LTS 4. On 2026-10-06 the owner (OWNER-DECISIONS 445): "I think I was too harsh with some of the east of the river options. Set the ones that look like normal roads back to whatever their LTS was." and, on East Capitol Street: "East Cap is a highway past the river. I don't think any map should plan with that." Tier 5 stays only on the main carriageways of Suitland Parkway SE (trunk and primary), Pennsylvania Avenue SE (trunk), Branch Avenue SE (trunk), Kenilworth Avenue NE (primary, but see 445f below), Indian Head Highway, South Capitol Street, South Capitol Street SW and SE (outside the stretch of 432), and East Capitol Street NE and SE (primary). The owner added: "However, there's some side streets that are fine" and "Just like north cap" (logged in OWNER-DECISIONS' "Record of owner words used in 444/445"). That is the North Capitol Street precedent (OWNER-DECISIONS 284, 286, 295): the highway-like main roadway is Avoid and the side lanes beside it are rated as ordinary streets. So the pieces of those roads that are not main carriageway are retired and the classifier rates them: the four secondary East Capitol Street NE ways of the lane that branches off the main roadway (0.22 mi, 0.36 km), the 26 secondary Kenilworth Avenue NE ways (2.02 mi, 3.25 km; one-lane one-way service lanes at 20 to 25 mph, in parallel pairs, while the primary pieces stay) and way 468835493 of Branch Avenue SE, the one-way 1-lane slip beside its 2-lane way 1508430121 between the same two nodes (0.04 mi, 62 m). A way is main carriageway when it is the road's highest class and contiguous with the rest of it; the file has no lane or link tags, so this was judged from each way's class, direction, lanes and where it joins. Every other row (Alabama Ave, Benning Rd, Martin Luther King Jr Ave, Mississippi Ave, Marion Barry Ave, Naylor Rd, Sheriff Rd, Fort Davis Dr, Texas Ave and the rest) is retired. The three Saint Elizabeths Rd SE rows left in this file are retired here as well; the military reopenings file retires and rates the road's other two. Floors, not Avoid: 445a, "Minnesota ave is probably LTS4 in many parts, not avoid. Bump it up if it would be lower. It's known for people to speed on it.": Minnesota Avenue SE and NE, all 89 ways, are tier 4 (category driver_behaviour); the classifier had them at 2 or 3. 445b, "The trunk part of Pennsylvania is avoid, the others are probably LTS4.": Pennsylvania Avenue SE's one primary way (468485667) is tier 4 (it is not contiguous with the trunk). 445c, "Nannie helen buroughs has a 25 mph in parts, but I'd bump it up to at least an LTS3, just because of the more aggressive drivers.": all 36 Nannie Helen Burroughs Avenue NE main carriageway ways are tier 3 (category driver_behaviour; the classifier rated five of them 2, 30 of them 3 and one 4). The tier-4 and tier-3 rows are floors (`"at_least": true`, pipeline.overrides): the rebuild rates each way max(the classifier's tier, the row's tier), so a way the classifier rates higher on a later extract keeps the higher tier, and a way it rates lower is raised to the floor. The new floor rows carry new adjustment ids ending -lts4 or -lts3; the Avoid rows they replace are in `retire` first, so loading is not refused as a conflict. Tier now, in each row's evidence, is the classifier's tier when the row was written. OWNER-DECISIONS 445d (2026-10-06): the owner named a stretch around 38.8961758,-76.9518693 to avoid, the Benning Rd NE / Kenilworth Avenue Freeway (DC 295) interchange, ending at 38.8976873,-76.9499615 ("the last you could pull off to a different spot", Foote Street NE on Kenilworth Avenue NE). Benning Road Northeast ways 962622875, 135146257, 135146261 and 135146277 (the two carriageways across the interchange, with both bridges; 135146277 is the bridge that 445 had retired) stay Avoid and are taken out of `retire`, and ramps 926566914 and 6056218 (primary_link) are written at Avoid; Kenilworth Avenue NE way 203015546 was already Avoid under 445 (retired again by 445f). The freeway and its motorway_link ramps are already barred, and Benning Road NE beyond the interchange keeps the classifier rating. OWNER-DECISIONS 445f (2026-10-07), after seeing Kenilworth Avenue NE on the map: "the map changes were in the exact opposite direction as they should have been on kenilworth." The two main-road ways kept Avoid by 445 and 445d, 203015546 (228 m) and 130808357 (122 m), run north-east of the Foote Street NE turn-off (38.8976873,-76.9499615), the side the owner did not mean, so both are retired and the classifier rates them. The interchange's ramps 926566914 and 6056218 and Benning Road NE across the interchange stay Avoid (445d). Roads only; the roughly 35 m of 203015546 between the turn-off and the ramp follow the classifier unless the way is split in OSM.
